notes: All separation, controller and maneuver parameters are research assumptions, not aviation standards or calibrated vehicle dynamics.
Three initially active aircraft per layout, not one aircraft in every lane/level; identical initial states within each four-way comparison.
Synthetic prescribed SINR field deliberately exercises decisions; no Bay Area geometry, radio kernel, loading or capacity results are claimed.
Closed fleet on an unbounded local straight axis: no departures, queues, arrivals or throughput estimates.
ACC-like proportional speed/spacing feedback is independent of C/R/F; no policy-dependent following or original MOBIL has been implemented.
Screening is sampled, not a continuous-time proof. Aircraft are points with an ellipsoidal protected region and dual-cell gap reservation.
This local benchmark does not impose the separate corridor-optimization 8000 m curvature rule. Global georeferenced maneuver feasibility remains future work.
No randomness; ID-ordered serial arbitration is deterministic, not a fairness guarantee. Future control decisions are not known to the predictor.
